note: Hand-curated public sources (read via web search on the access date, no login). Numbers quoted are the SOURCE's claims, not ours; third-party keyword tools are estimates.

sources.title: AKC: Most Popular Dog Breeds of 2025
sources.finding: Top 10 US breeds 2025: French Bulldog, Labrador Retriever, Golden Retriever, German Shepherd, Dachshund, Poodle, Beagle, Rottweiler, German Shorthaired Pointer, Bulldog. Dachshund up to #5; Cane Corso #11 rising.

sources.title: What Pet Product Designs Actually Sell on Etsy
sources.type: third-party study of 1,097 top Etsy listings
sources.finding: Illustrated custom pet portraits were 43% of top listings but ~70% of 'winners' (1.63x over-index); name-on-collar/tag products under-index (0.56x). Median price ~$14.95; only ~60% of listings run ads.

sources.title: 'personalized pet portrait' keyword data
sources.finding: ~1,300 avg monthly Etsy searches, ~215k competing listings, typical price ~$19.99. Strongly seasonal: ~720 (Oct 2025) → 2,400 (Nov) → 5,400 (Dec) → 1,600 (Jan); low in summer.

sources.title: 'personalized pet' keyword data
sources.finding: ~720 avg monthly searches, ~670k listings (very crowded), median price ~$28; use as a supporting tag, not the main keyword.

sources.title: How to Create Pet Portrait Products on Print-on-Demand
sources.finding: Breed-specific (non-custom) designs scale: one breed illustration → mug, tee, canvas, blanket, phone case, tote. Canvas $55–85 is highest AOV; breed mugs $17–20; 'Golden Retriever Mom Mug' cited as a top mug search.

sources.title: Etsy Seller Trend Report: Spring and Summer 2026
sources.finding: 'Just because' gifting growing ("petit cadeau" searches +277%); recommends gift-recipient framing and personalization; Mother's Day shopping Feb–May.

sources.title: Why Renaissance pet portraits became 2026's most-shared gift
sources.finding: Claims Royal/Renaissance style drives much of pet-portrait growth and notes Etsy's AI-disclosure requirement for listings. Treat as a style hint only.
